data.name: Myriad Gate
data.detailed_description: Myriad Gate is a sci‑fi high‑fantasy extraction RPG where you explore unstable alien worlds, gather valuable resources, and fight to escape before it’s too late. Extraction missions are the heart of the experience—high‑risk expeditions where you scavenge rare materials, battle hostile creatures, and race to reach an exit before the zone collapses. Beyond extraction, you can dive into a story‑driven campaign that uncovers the mysteries behind the Myriad Gate and the strange realms it connects. Explore ancient ruins, meet unusual and evil factions, and slowly piece together the truth behind the world’s instability. For players who want fast‑paced action, the arena mode lets you team up with friends to test builds, abilities, and combat skills in controlled combat challenges. Use everything you bring back—whether from extraction runs, campaign missions, or arena victories—to craft new gear, upgrade your starship, expand your home base, and unlock new abilities. Each successful run strengthens your character and opens new paths through the realms.

data.short_description: Myriad Gate is an intergalactic extraction RPG where players venture into alien frontiers to claim the unknown. Scavenge resources and secure biological specimens to fuel a modular crafting system, then survive the warp home to transform your starship and residence with your collections.
